name: Cat Lady
summary: Players draft cats, food, toys and costumes from a 3x3 grid to build the highest-scoring cat collection.
rules_text: Shuffle game cards (trimmed by player count: remove 3+ and 4 marks for 2 players, 4 marks for 3 players, plus 2 random cards for 2-3 players) as main deck and 13 stray cats as separate deck. Deal 9 cards face up as 3x3 grid and 3 stray cats face up. Place food cubes and cat blocking token aside. On your turn you must take all 3 cards from one row or column not blocked by the cat token. Resolve cards: cats stay in front of you, toys go to hand for set scoring, food cubes are taken and discarded cards replaced by cubes, costumes, catnip etc score, Lost Cat and Spray Bottle may be played anytime on your turn to claim strays or steal. After taking, move cat token to the row/column you took and refill those 3 spots from main deck. Continue clockwise until the deck cannot refill a row or column. Then apply -2 VP to player(s) with most leftover food, sum VP from fed cats, stray cats, costumes, catnip sets, toy sets, tokens and penalties. Highest total wins, tie-break most fed cats.
rating_reason: Card drafting set collection, turn-based strategic fits engine
